component.name: Bottles RetroCD
component.summary: Run Windows retro CD/DVD games inside a hardened Bottles sandbox

description.p: Bottles RetroCD is a GTK4 controller for running legacy Windows PC games through native Bottles inside a dedicated Bubblejail instance, with CDEmu/UDisks2 optical-media integration and read-only Redump/TOSEC verification workflows.
The 0.4.0 release uses deny-by-default host exposure, transient networking, strict selected-GPU isolation, verified read-only optical mounts and exact-node standard gamepad handling.
